projects.title: Scalable Serverless Notification Pipeline
projects.description: Built a serverless notification system that supports both real-time and scheduled notifications for a large user base. It handles audience targeting, batching, token management, and mobile delivery — all without overloading the system.
projects.highlight: Processes large-volume notifications with batching, scheduling, and multi-channel support

details.overview: I built a serverless notification system that supports both real-time and scheduled notifications for a large user base. It handles audience targeting, batching, token management, and mobile delivery — all without overloading the system. The pipeline uses AWS Lambda, SQS, and EventBridge to process high-volume notification traffic efficiently, and Firebase FCM for mobile delivery.
whatIBuilt: Event-driven notification triggers for posts, actions, reminders, etc.
Controller logic that validates requests, resolves audiences, and schedules jobs
Batch-based processing using queues to prevent load spikes
Subscriber preparation (user lookups, FCM token mapping, delivery eligibility)
Push delivery service using Firebase multicast + failure tracking
Support for both immediate and scheduled notifications
details.simpleTerms: Events come in → system finds the right users → batches them → queues them → sends notifications reliably and at scale.

projects.title: Secure Single Sign-On (SSO) System + NPM SDK
projects.description: Designed and implemented a secure authentication workflow enabling external applications to authenticate users through a central identity provider. The system supports multiple login methods and provides encrypted token exchange for secure data transfer.
projects.highlight: Published NPM package enabling external apps to authenticate users through Vaave SSO

details.overview: Designed and implemented a secure authentication workflow enabling external applications to authenticate users through a central identity provider. The system supports multiple login methods and provides encrypted token exchange for secure data transfer.

npmPackage.name: vaave-sso-sdk
npmPackage.description: Published vaave-sso-sdk, an NPM package that simplifies SSO integration for partner applications.

features: Reusable NPM SDK for integrating external apps with the SSO platform
Validation layer to ensure only authorized applications can authenticate users
impact: Unified authentication flow across multiple apps

projects.title: Feature Flag & Coupon System
projects.description: Built a dynamic feature-flag system and production-grade coupon engine to support controlled feature rollouts and safe experimentation, especially for payment-critical flows. Enables instant feature toggles without app releases or risky OTA deployments.
projects.highlight: Dynamic rollout system + rule-based coupon engine with safe payment flow handling

details.overview: Designed and implemented a dual-system solution: a lightweight feature-flag framework for instant production toggles and a comprehensive coupon engine with rule-based validation and payment-safe hold mechanisms. Built to support safe experimentation and prevent payment-related issues during high-traffic scenarios.

sections.title: Feature Flag System (Safe Rollouts)
sections.description: A lightweight feature-flag framework designed for payment-critical features requiring instant shutdown capability without app releases or OTA updates.
features: Single backend call retrieves all feature flags
Flags cached on login for fast access
Feature checks load from cache - zero performance impact
No app release or OTA update required
impact: Enabled safer deployment of sensitive features
Reduced outage risk during new rollouts
Allowed instant feature toggles in production

sections.title: Coupon System (Rule Engine + Safe Payment Handling)
sections.description: A full-featured coupon engine with rule-based validation and a hold mechanism to prevent race conditions during checkout.
features: Limited coupons with usage count tracking
Product-level rules (restrict to specific product types)
Hold mechanism: 4-minute reservation window prevents race conditions
Reduces double-redemption errors and payment failures
impact: Significantly reduced failed redemptions during peak usage
Improved payment success rate and user experience
Reduced customer support tickets related to coupon failures
Real-time usage tracking with safety guarantees
Reduced payment-related errors and customer support load
Enabled instant production control without deployments
